chunks: That is from the news of the Unseen which We reveal to you, and you were not with them when they cast lots with their quills as to which of them would be responsible for Mary, nor were you with them when they disputed.

key_terms.يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَامَهُمْ: They cast lots with their quills

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Prophet Muhammad's presence during the guardianship of Mary?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the miraculous nature of Maryam’s guardianship, often linking the 'casting of lots' (qur'at) to the Prophet Zakariyya (AS) and the twelve tribes of Israel, underscoring divine selection over human merit. It serves as a foundational text for the purity (Ismah) of the Ahl al-Bayt, as Maryam is the mother of Imam al-Mahdi (AJ), connecting the Unseen revelation to the lineage of the Imams. The verse emphasizes that the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) received these details through divine inspiration rather than historical observation, validating the supernatural origin of the narrative.
